## Purpose

Describe the problem, intended outcome, and why this change belongs in the
unified Jarvis product.

## Affected components

- [ ] Brain/Core
- [ ] Conversation, memory, realtime, or durable work
- [ ] Home Assistant, presence, proactive work, cameras, or vision
- [ ] External Agent, Web/research, or Integrations
- [ ] Android Phone
- [ ] Wear OS / shared protocol
- [ ] Developer/Codex or self-improvement
- [ ] Release, deployment, OTA, documentation, or CI

## Behavior change

Describe user-visible, protocol, API, capability-state, or operational changes.
State explicitly when behavior is unchanged.

## Data and compatibility

- [ ] Existing databases and persistent mounts remain compatible.
- [ ] Phone/Watch updates preserve package identity and application data.
- [ ] Protocol or schema migrations are documented and tested, if applicable.

## Security and authorization

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private data, logs, or signing material are included.
- [ ] Authentication, principal scope, approval policy, and capability truth remain enforced.
- [ ] External writes still require execution evidence and durable receipts.

## Tests run

List exact commands, results, skips, and relevant CI evidence.

## Physical validation

Record Phone, Watch, Home Assistant, or deployment checks that actually ran.
Use **Required** rather than claiming success when hardware or infrastructure
was unavailable.

## Rollback and recovery

Describe the safe rollback or recovery path and any preserved data/state.

## Release impact

State whether this changes Core deployment, Phone/Watch artifacts, versioning,
signing, manifests, OTA feeds, or has no release impact.
